title: Knocking on the glass
brief: You're Tomás, inside your grandmother's closed café on your first morning. An older man is tapping on the window and wants his coffee. He's older than you and a stranger, so use usted. Tell him who you are, find out about him, and send him off happy.

turns.npcEn: Good morning! Excuse me, do you speak Spanish?
turns.intent: Say good morning, and tell him yes, you speak Spanish.
accept: Hola, buenos días, señor. Sí, hablo español.

turns.npcEn: Oh, good! Are you one of Rosa's customers?
turns.intent: Tell him no: you're Tomás, from Toronto.
accept: No, soy Tomás. Soy de Toronto.
No, señor. Soy Tomás, de Toronto.
No. Soy Tomás y soy de Toronto.

turns.npc: ¿Tomás? ¿El Tomás de Rosa? ¡Mucho gusto! Yo soy Hernando, un amigo de Rosa.
turns.npcEn: Tomás? Rosa's Tomás? Nice to meet you! I'm Hernando, a friend of Rosa's.
turns.intent: Say it's nice to meet him, and ask him if he's a teacher. Remember: usted.

turns.npcEn: A teacher? No, sir! Are you a doctor, Tomás?
turns.intent: Say no, you're not a doctor: you're an engineer.
accept: No, señor. No soy médico. Soy ingeniero.
No soy médico, señor. Soy ingeniero.

require.label: a job after soy takes no un

turns.npc: ¿Ingeniero? ¡Ah, bueno! Entonces, un tinto, por favor.
turns.npcEn: An engineer? Oh, good! So, a coffee, please.
turns.intent: Tell him you're sorry: there's no coffee, but there is water.
accept: Qué pena, señor. No hay tinto. Hay agua.
Qué pena, no hay tinto, pero hay agua.
Perdón, señor. No hay tinto, pero hay agua.

turns.npc: ¿No hay tinto? ¡Ay, Rosa! Bueno, agua, por favor. Gracias, Tomás.
turns.npcEn: No coffee? Oh, Rosa! Fine, water, please. Thank you, Tomás.
turns.intent: Say you're welcome, and that you're at his service.
accept: De nada, señor. A la orden.
